description: This script implements a client for fetching web pages using either wget or a custom quic_client, with capabilities to read page URLs from a JSON file, measure download times, and record packet information. It includes classes and functions for running experiments and processing network data.

classes.name: PageloadExperiment
classes.description: Class to configure and run web page load experiments using wget or quic_client, including reading URLs from JSON, downloading pages, and recording delays and packet info.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in microseconds or converts a given datetime to timestamp.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the experiment with options for using wget, binary directory, server address, and port.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.ReadPages
methods.description: Reads a JSON file containing pages and resources, returning a list of URL lists.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.DownloadOnePage
methods.description: Downloads a page (or resource list) using wget or quic_client, returning download time and max packet number.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.RunExperiment
methods.description: Runs the experiment for a specified number of iterations, recording delays and packet data into CSV files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses command-line options, creates an experiment instance, and runs it.
